info.title: API.SH: Arket
info.description: The Arket API from API.SH: public Arket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Every size of a product with its SKU, EAN and current online stock in the chosen market (in stock, low on stock, out of stock). A light call for frequent stock checks.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com product link; its market and language are used unless given. Give this or `slug`.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The product's slug (the last part of its link, ending in the 10-digit article number), e.g. `tailored-wool-blend-coat-dark-green-1313766001`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets the price, currency and stock. Default: the link's market, else GB.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names and labels. Default: the market's own.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The store's category menu in one market: every entry's name, the category path /arket/v1/category takes, its link and its children.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets prices, currency and language. Default GB.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one Arket category in one market, with the same fields, facets, sort, filters and paging as /arket/v1/search. Take category paths from /arket/v1/categories or a product's `category`; a category link from the site works too.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category path, e.g. `women/jacketscoats/coats`. Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com category link (e.g. https://www.arket.com/de-de/women/clothing/); its market is used unless `country` is given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets prices, currency and language. Default GB.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet filter as `<facet id>:<value>` from `facets` (e.g. `color:BLACK`, `custom.fit:Regular Fit`); several values of one facet as `color:BLACK|WHITE`; repeat the parameter (or separate with commas) to combine facets.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the market's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, in the market's currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-200). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page (1-48, default 48).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Arket product in one market: article number, name (and English name), colour, price, previous price and 30-day lowest price with the ISO currency (e.g. CHF, EUR), sale flag, every size with its SKU, EAN and online stock (in stock, low on stock, out of stock), composition, category, description and images, and the other colours of the same model (article, colour, price, availability, link). 404 when the product is not sold in that market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com product link; its market and language are used unless given. Give this or `slug`.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The product's slug (the last part of its link, ending in the 10-digit article number), e.g. `tailored-wool-blend-coat-dark-green-1313766001`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets the price, currency and stock. Default: the link's market, else GB.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names and labels. Default: the market's own.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products recommended for one product: similar alternatives (default) or the pieces the site styles it with, each with the same fields as search results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-recommendations

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com product link. Give this, `slug` or `article`.

parameters.name: article
parameters.description: The product's 10-digit article number (alternatives only).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The product's slug, e.g. `tailored-wool-blend-coat-dark-green-1313766001`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: alternatives (default) or style_with.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market. Default: the link's, else GB.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one product in one market: average rating, review count and fit dimensions (true to size, length), then the reviews (rating, text, date, purchase date, reviewer first name, fit answers, size and colour bought), ten per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com product link. Give this, `slug` or `article`.

parameters.name: article
parameters.description: The 10-digit article number.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The product's slug.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market of the reviews. Default: the link's, else GB.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language: en, sv, de, fr, it, pl, es or da (default: the market's).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (ten reviews a page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Arket for keywords (or a 10-digit article or 7-digit model number) in one market: each with article number, name, colour, price, previous and 30-day lowest price, ISO currency, sale and new flags, number of colours, category, link and images, plus the facets to filter by (colour, size, product type, material, fit, length, pattern, department, brand) with counts, the total and paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-search

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets prices, currency and language. Default GB.

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet filter as `<facet id>:<value>` from `facets` (e.g. `color:BLACK`, `custom.fit:Regular Fit`); several values of one facet as `color:BLACK|WHITE`; repeat the parameter (or separate with commas) to combine facets.

parameters.description: Lowest price, in the market's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, in the market's currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-200). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page (1-48, default 48).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The size guide for a category or a product: size conversion and body measurement tables (header row and rows) and how to measure.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-size-guide

parameters.name: url

get.description:
Which stores in one country hold an article (one colour), with the quantity per size and in total, and each store's address, position and hours. Stores without it are not listed.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-store-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An arket.com product link (gives size labels). Give this, `slug` or `article`.

parameters.name: article
parameters.description: The 10-digit article number.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The product's slug.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code of the stores (default: the link's market).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Arket store in one country with address, position, phone, store type and opening hours (with exceptions). Without `country`: the countries that have stores.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, CH, GB, SE, NL, KR); omit to list the countries.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search-as-you-type suggestions for the start of a query: suggested phrases, matching categories (with their paths) and products.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arket-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a search.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets prices, currency and language. Default GB.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
